slots.prompt_rule: Five one-line facts from the book with one blank; the five answers, mixed, in "words" on the FIRST item.

Five statements from the book; options exactly درست and غلط. Mix both answers.

Five pairs to match, no options: the question is the thing (Column A) and the answer is what goes with it (Column B), five different answers (an animal and its home, a job and its tool, a sign and its meaning). The paper prints Column B shuffled. The answer is the Column B words alone, never the pair or an arrow.

slots.prompt_rule: Four book things (a body part, a traffic sign, a fruit, a tool) as picture: {kind:"object", name} in English for the artist. Put all four Urdu names, mixed, in "words" on the FIRST item only. Answer: the Urdu name. The picture is a plain black-outline drawing a child names at once: never a thing whose outline alone is unreadable (egg, ball, plate, cup, watch, bench, box). A small object placed in a scene is drawn large and in front.
Four questions on good habits, cleanliness, water and sources of income. Answer: one or two short sentences. Scheme: K 1 per idea.
One book topic (my school, my home, keeping clean). Answer: four model sentences. Scheme: K 1 per sentence on topic.
Three items, each three steps of a book routine (washing hands, crossing the road, planting a seed) written out of order and numbered. Answer: the order, e.g. 2، 1، 3.

The picture is a plain black-outline drawing a child names at once: never a thing whose outline alone is unreadable (egg, ball, plate, cup, watch, bench, box). slots.instruction_ur: یہ کہاں رہتا ہے؟ خشکی، پانی یا دونوں۔
slots.prompt_rule: Five book animals only, some that live on land and some that live in water, never a vehicle or any other object, each as picture: {kind:"object", name}. Answer: خشکی or پانی; an animal of land and water (a crocodile, frog, turtle or duck) is keyed خشکی اور پانی دونوں. The picture is a plain black-outline drawing a child names at once: never a thing whose outline alone is unreadable (egg, ball, plate, cup, watch, bench, box). A small object placed in a scene is drawn large and in front.
